descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Billiards puts a full-size pool table in a glass penthouse high above a living city. The sun sets through the floor-to-ceiling window, pods and drones drift past, and a sky liner crosses the skyline while you line up your shot.

THE CUE FEELS REAL
Hold the cue in your right hand. Put your left hand out in front and it becomes your bridge: the cue slides through it and your aim is the line between your two hands. Squeeze the left trigger to lock that line, then stroke straight through the cue ball. Hit low for draw, high for follow, off-centre for side. A guide line shows where the cue ball will go, where the object ball will travel, and where the cue ball goes after contact.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- PRACTICE: sink what you like, pick the cue ball up any time, re-rack from the menu.
- 8-BALL: two players passing one headset. Open table, solids and stripes, fouls and ball in hand, and the 8 to finish. The scoreboard over the table keeps track.
- SPEED POOL: sink all fifteen against the clock. Your best time is remembered.

THE PENTHOUSE
Sixteen balls with real rolling friction and recorded ball, cushion, pocket and break sounds. Five skies on the pedestal by the glass: sunset, daylight, dawn, emerald and neon dusk. A lounge to sit in, a gallery wall, a cue rack, and a balcony 300 metres up. Six original music tracks on the menu.

No account, no internet, nothing collected. Just you, the table and the view.
